verdict.rationale: Lium's docs say every pod has root and Docker-in-Docker, so a developer can run their own Docker image inside a pod. The docs also mention "default templates", but nothing shows you can supply a custom image or template as the pod's base environment. Missing for 10: documented custom Docker image selection for pods, user-created or saved custom templates, a registry or private-image workflow, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my own Docker image or custom machine template with my exact environment

citations.quote: root and Docker-in-Docker on every pod; pod volumes encrypted at rest by default on the default templates
